tasks.brief: IMPLEMENTATION CONSTRAINTS: Create a new file at src/static/rain.js. Use only vanilla JavaScript (no libraries). Must be a self-contained IIFE. Use requestAnimationFrame for the animation loop. Use a monospace font stack. Use a canvas element with data-testid="matrix-rain". Ensure pointer-events is 'none' and zIndex is 0. Handle document visibility changes to pause/resume the loop. Handle window resize to adjust canvas dimensions. Use a specific set of glyphs (katakana 0x30A0..0x30FF plus digits 0-9). Draw green text with a brighter head. Provide start() and stop() methods on window.MatrixRain. Do not use any external assets. BEHAVIORAL SPECIFICATION: The script initializes a canvas-based matrix rain effect. On start(), it creates the canvas if not present, sets up the animation loop, and handles visibility/resize events. On stop(), it cancels the animation and hides the canvas. The rain draws columns of falling glyphs, with a brighter head for each column. The animation respects prefers-reduced-motion by drawing a single frame if that media query matches. ACCEPTANCE CONDITION: The file src/static/rain.js exists, contains a function definition, and uses requestAnimationFrame. The window.MatrixRain object has start and stop methods. The canvas element has the correct data-testid and styles.

IMPLEMENTATION CONSTRAINTS: Edit src/static/style.css. Append a new CSS block for [data-theme="phosphor"]. Do not modify any existing CSS rules outside this appended block. Use the exact variable names defined in the existing 'matrix' theme block. Use oklch color values as specified. Override border-radius to 0.25rem. Set font-family to ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace. Add a .matrix-scanlines overlay using a repeating-linear-gradient ::before on the chat panel. Add text-shadow for text glow on assistant text and headers. Add .box-glow for terminal-ish containers. Ensure the app chrome sits above the rain canvas (position relative / z-index 1 on the app wrapper). BEHAVIORAL SPECIFICATION: The phosphor theme block defines a set of CSS variables for background, foreground, primary, secondary, cards, borders, and focus ring. It also defines visual effects like scanlines, text glow, and box glow. The app wrapper is positioned to sit above the rain canvas. ACCEPTANCE CONDITION: The file src/static/style.css contains the [data-theme="phosphor"] block with the specified variables and effects. The matrix-scanlines class is present.

IMPLEMENTATION CONSTRAINTS: Edit src/static/index.html. Insert a <script src="/static/rain.js"></script> tag BEFORE the existing app.js script tag. Do not modify any other part of the HTML file. BEHAVIORAL SPECIFICATION: The rain.js script is loaded before app.js so that window.MatrixRain is available when app.js runs. ACCEPTANCE CONDITION: The file src/static/index.html contains the script tag for rain.js before the app.js script tag.

IMPLEMENTATION CONSTRAINTS: Edit src/static/app.js. In the THEMES array, add 'phosphor' after 'matrix'. Add a toggle icon mapping for 'phosphor' in THEME_ICONS (use a non-emoji marker like '>_' or '𐌘'). In applyTheme(), after setting the data-theme attribute, add a conditional: if theme === 'phosphor', call window.MatrixRain.start(), else call window.MatrixRain.stop(). Guard the MatrixRain calls with typeof window.MatrixRain !== 'undefined'. Do not modify any other part of app.js. BEHAVIORAL SPECIFICATION: The phosphor theme is registered in the theme system. When the phosphor theme is applied, the matrix rain starts; when any other theme is applied, the matrix rain stops. The rain is safely guarded against missing script loads. ACCEPTANCE CONDITION: The THEMES array includes 'phosphor'. The THEME_ICONS map includes an entry for 'phosphor'. The applyTheme function calls MatrixRain.start/stop based on the theme. The tests tests/test_ui.py::test_theme_cycle_reaches_phosphor_and_wraps and tests/test_ui.py::test_rain_backdrop_only_in_phosphor pass after this task.
